pages.title: Special Species
pages.text: These bees are the pinnacle of breeding or are obtained through unique means. They possess powerful traits and produce valuable resources.

$(li)Emerald Bee: Produces Emeralds.$(br)$(li)Diamond Bee: Produces Diamonds.$(br)$(li)Obsidian Bee: A very slow but tough bee that produces Obsidian.$(br)$(li)Amethyst Bee: Produces Amethyst Shards.$(br)$(li)Ancient Debris Bee: The ultimate bee, produces Netherite Scrap and is invulnerable.

pages.title: Worker & Utility Bees
pages.text: $(li)Farming Bee: Harvests crops.$(br)$(li)Mining Bee: Mines stone-type blocks.$(br)$(li)Fighting Bee: Attacks monsters.$(br)$(li)Breeze Bee: Produces Breeze Rods.$(br)$(li)Light Bee: Illuminates its surroundings.$(br)$(li)Rideable Bee: Can be ridden by players.
